stakeholders.label: Regional electricity grid operator (heat pump and PV connection)
Municipal drainage and water utility (rainwater retention)
Residents of the streets next to the school site
Neighbouring day-care centre and sports club
Local initiative for a safe school route
Local paper of the Ludwigsburg district
Technischer Ausschuss of the Gemeinderat (client committee)

assessment.rationale: Initial stakeholder analysis workshop with the Hochbauamt and the school
assessment.drift_rationale: After the Elternabend the neighbours' tone changed once the delivery routes were explained

newsletter.title: Neighbour and parent newsletter
newsletter.purpose: Keep neighbours and school families informed about works, deliveries and noisy phases next to the running school
newsletter.key_message: What happens next month, which routes are closed, and whom to call

evening.title: Information evening in the school hall
evening.purpose: Present the site logistics plan and the safe school route during construction, and collect concerns from neighbours and parents
evening.outcome: Main concerns: heavy deliveries at drop-off time, dust and noise during lessons, blocked school route and bicycle racks
evening.feedback_summary: Answers to all concerns sent to parents with the following newsletter and posted on the school notice board

authority_meeting.title: Authority coordination with Baurechtsamt and fire service
authority_meeting.purpose: Coordinate building permit conditions, the fire safety concept review and inspections

briefing.title: Briefing for the Technischer Ausschuss
briefing.purpose: Brief the client committee on stakeholder status before each Gemeinderat decision

site_tour.title: Site tour for the Bezirksbeirat
site_tour.outcome: The advisory council asked for a progress update before the summer holidays and for a named contact at the school
site_tour.feedback_summary: Update sent with the newsletter and presented at the next Bezirksbeirat meeting

commitments.text: No heavy deliveries during school drop-off and pick-up, delivery window 09:00 to 15:00 on school days
commitments.verification: Gate log of delivery times, checked weekly with the Schulleitung

commitments.text: Wheel washing at the site exit and weekly sweeping of the school access road
Signed safe school route diversion for pedestrians and bicycles before the access road closes
commitments.verification: Signage plan approved by the road authority and agreed with the Elternbeirat

commitments.text: Monthly noise and dust measurement report, with quiet periods during exams
commitments.verification: Report attached to the newsletter and sent to the Schulleitung

commitments.text: Contact person and hotline number on the site hoarding and on the school website
commitments.verification: Photo of the hoarding and link to the school page
